column1: # Discovery targets for scripts/discover_ins_info.py, fetched through the
# Taiwan relay by .github/workflows/discover-ins-info.yml.
# Format: note<TAB>url   (a line with no tab is treated as the url itself)
# Pass 1 (2026-09-05) maps the portal's entry points. The goal is the
# FIRM-LEVEL disclosures behind the per-company menu — fund utilisation by
# insurer (the hedge-ratio denominator per firm rather than for the sector),
# capital adequacy, and the note that would split 特別盈餘公積 into its
# FX-designated buckets, which decisions 4.19 can currently only bound.
# Known-good endpoints are included as controls: if they fail, the relay or
# the portal is at fault and nothing else in the pass means anything.

# customer/RPT-<code>.aspx page, but only three with a known opendata JSON
# endpoint. If the json-<code>.aspx pattern holds for all ten, seven more
# machine-readable tables land at once. openData.aspx should say so

# Pass 3 (2026-09-05). Pass 2 result: all ten aggregate tables have JSON
# endpoints (seven new), but NONE is fund utilisation or capital adequacy per
# firm — those live behind the per-company menu, and every page carrying it is
# an ASP.NET WebForms postback that a GET-only relay cannot parameterise.
# One opening: customer/life.aspx returned a NULL-REFERENCE error, not a 404,
# so it exists and expects a parameter. If it takes UID by query string the
# per-company disclosures are reachable without POST at all. 03557115 is a
# real UID (臺灣產物, from the shareholder table); the root dropdown gives the
# rest, captured this pass as a full company-to-UID map.

# Pass 4 (2026-09-05). Pass 3 found the opening: Info2-2.aspx?UID=<8-digit id>
# returns a PER-COMPANY BALANCE SHEET by plain GET, 122KB, no postback needed.
# So the firm-level disclosures are URL-addressable and the whole per-company
# menu should be Info2-N for some range of N. This pass walks that range to
# learn which N is which report -- the titles say so -- looking above all for
# 資金運用表 (fund utilisation: the hedge-ratio denominator per firm) and
# 資本適足性 (capital adequacy per firm).
# 03557115 is 臺灣產物 (non-life), the one UID confirmed to work. 03557017 is
# 台灣人壽's business-registration number from the TWSE registry: if it answers,
# UID is simply the 統一編號 and every firm in the panel is addressable.

# Pass 5 (2026-09-05). Pass 4 mapped the whole per-company menu and confirmed
# UID = 統一編號 (台灣人壽's 03557017 returns its 資金運用表 and 資產負債表):
#   Info2-1  資金運用表          <- the hedge-ratio denominator PER FIRM
#   Info2-2  資產負債表          Info2-3  綜合損益表      Info2-4  權益變動表
#   Info2-5  準備金              <- may split the special-reserve buckets (4.19)
#   Info2-9  現金流量表          Info2-12 各項財務業務指標
#   Info2-14 其他負債項下之服務合約負債、特別準備及其他準備   <- likewise
# What is missing is the other five firms' 統編. The portal root's dropdown
# lists only the 22 non-life insurers, so the life list must be reachable
# another way: a type parameter on the root, or the company selector on a
# page that is already showing a life insurer.

# Pass 6 (2026-09-05). The reserve page has two layouts. A company whose
# latest data is pre-IFRS17 (the absorbed Shin Kong, UID 03458902) renders the
# OLD one: ten LABELLED rows across three years, including 外匯價格變動準備
# explicitly. Active firms render the 2026 one: seven rows whose 項目 cells are
# literally   in the source, so the FX reserve is in there (the page title
# says so) but cannot be identified -- no row matches any firm's known balance.
# If the layout follows the requested PERIOD rather than the company, then
# asking an active firm for a pre-2026 period returns the labelled table and
# with it a firm-level FX-reserve history. These are the plausible parameter
# names; all are harmless if ignored.
